next_review: In 12 months, or sooner once the board decides on tools
why: We want AI to take paperwork off your plate and help with reports. We also want to protect families, students and donors, and never send out something wrong under our name.
who_it_covers: Staff, volunteers, contractors and board members.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot
tools.approved_for: Pilot for the development team and Luis (8 licenses). May hold donor names and gift amounts. No case file or student information.

tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.approved_for: Work email only. Nothing about a real person.

new_tools: Luis approves any new tool, plugin, AI agent or AI feature in software we own, after checking where data goes and whether the vendor trains on it. Client data also needs Grace, our privacy officer.
accounts: Use your work email, and turn off any setting that lets the vendor train on what you type.
everyone_now: Anyone may use ChatGPT or Copilot for work with nothing about a real person in it. Teachers may also make lesson materials and translate handouts, with no student names or scores.
allowed_uses: Reword an email, brainstorm, or have a form explained.
Teachers: lesson plans, reading passages, GED practice questions, Spanish handout translations.
Development team and Luis, in Copilot: draft appeals and thank-you letters, summarize grant guidelines.

needs_approval.use: Any tool with a family's name or client information
needs_approval.approver: Luis and Grace, our privacy officer

needs_approval.use: Any tool with student names, scores, grades or attendance
needs_approval.approver: Luis and Grace, our privacy officer

needs_approval.use: County contract or grant reports with AI-drafted text
needs_approval.approver: Not set yet; see open questions

protected_information: Case files: family names, addresses, income, immigration status, children's names, domestic violence history, mental health and substance use notes (county contract). Student names, scores, grades, attendance (district agreement). Donor giving history and gift notes, except donor names and gift amounts in the Copilot pilot. Staff HR files. Passwords and logins.
off_limits: Browser plugins or extensions that read your email.
AI-generated photos presented as real families we serve.
AI-written public statements about news events. A person writes them.
check_before_it_goes_out: A person reads everything AI helps write. Check facts, names, numbers, tone and bias, especially every number in county and grant reports. Whoever sends it is responsible.
decisions_about_people: AI never decides emergency assistance funds or class placement, and never scores intake essays. Caseworkers and teachers decide.
being_open: A person signs every donor letter. We label AI-made class materials, and tell funders honestly when AI helped with grant writing.
if_something_goes_wrong: Tell Luis and Grace the same day, even if unsure. Grace decides if client data is a breach under the county contract. No one is punished for reporting.
who_owns_this: Luis owns this policy, keeps it current, and runs a one-hour training for everyone. The board approves the policy and changes.
open_questions: Should we buy ChatGPT Team, extend Copilot to everyone, or neither?
